item.description: The RDS DBInstance validation logic produces an incorrect error message when validating credentials requirements. The current implementation raises a different error message than what the test expects. The test expects: "Either (MasterUsername and either MasterUserPassword or ManageMasterUserPassword) or DBSnapshotIdentifier are required" but the implementation raises: "MasterUsername is required when neither DBSnapshotIdentifier, DBClusterIdentifier, nor SourceDBInstanceIdentifier is provided."
item.contract: The validation should raise a ValueError with the exact error message: "Either (MasterUsername and either MasterUserPassword or ManageMasterUserPassword) or DBSnapshotIdentifier are required" when credentials are not provided along with snapshot/cluster/replica identifiers.

item.description: The AnycastIpList class uses validate_tags_or_list validator for Tags property, but the validator in /app/code/troposphere/validators/__init__.py doesn't properly validate the structure for AnycastIpList. The test expects strict validation that Tags must be a dict with only an "Items" key containing Tag objects, but the current validator accepts broader structures.
item.contract: The Tags property for AnycastIpList should enforce that Tags is a dictionary with exactly one key "Items", and the value of Items must be a list of Tag objects (or equivalent structures) that conform to the expected format.

item.description: The JobDefinition class incorrectly allows Tag objects in the Tags parameter. The test expects a TypeError to be raised when Tag objects are passed as the Tags value, but currently it allows them. The Tags property should only accept dictionaries, not Tag objects.
item.contract: The Tags property in JobDefinition should only accept dictionary values and raise TypeError when Tag objects are passed.
